what_this_is: The catalogue of MCP servers that register-mcp is able to add to the user's user-scope settings.json. It is NOT a .mcp.json and Claude Code never reads it. Nothing here is spawned, referenced or discovered by the plugin manager; it is inert data read only by plugin/scripts/mcp_registration.py when the user explicitly runs register-mcp. ADR-019 forbids bundling servers, and this file bundles none - it bundles the knowledge of which servers exist so the user does not have to hand-write a settings entry.

servers.description: Per-tool-call progress and commit-readiness projection. Replaces the PostToolUse hook's progress writing once that hook is deleted (PRD FR-4).
Local version-push gate. Ports the PreToolUse push_gate policy to an MCP tool so the guarantee survives hook deletion.
servers.not_built_yet: V2-024 owns this server. Until it lands, register-mcp reports this capability as unavailable rather than writing an entry that points at a file which does not exist.
